name: Chronicle AI history dataset
description: 78 milestones in the history of artificial intelligence from 1943 to 2026, each dated, categorized, scored for significance under a published rubric and linked to its primary source.
attribution: Chronicle AI history dataset (https://epoch.founden.co/data), CC BY 4.0

fields.description: Stable identifier of the event, also its dossier slug.
When it happened: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY when only the year is established.
Calendar year.
day, month or year: how precisely the date is known.
The subject as people name and search for it, for example Turing test.
Editorial headline.
The person, lab or institution behind it.
Models, Research, Launches, Open source, Benchmarks, Policy, Culture or Robotics.
What happened, in one sentence.
Why it mattered, in one sentence.
Editorial significance from 0 to 100: the weighted sum of the 5 ratings under rubric 1.0.
Defining (80 to 100), Major (60 to 79) or Notable (0 to 59).
Established, Supported or Provisional: how settled the evidence and historical perspective are. It does not change the score.
Conceptual shift, 0 to 5, worth 30% of the score: How much did this change the available approach?
Downstream influence, 0 to 5, worth 25% of the score: How much subsequent research or practice does it underpin?
Breadth of impact, 0 to 5, worth 20% of the score: How widely did the change matter beyond its original setting?
Access & diffusion, 0 to 5, worth 15% of the score: How much did it enable others to use or build on the work?
Institutional change, 0 to 5, worth 10% of the score: Did it change lasting infrastructure, governance, or incentives?
The original paper, announcement or archive record.
Sources cited in the event's dossier.
The event's full, cited dossier.

events.name: McCulloch-Pitts neuron
events.title: A mathematical neuron
events.summary: A logical model connects simplified neurons with computation.
events.impact: Neural activity becomes a subject of formal computational analysis.

events.name: Turing test
events.title: The question that started it all
events.summary: Turing proposes the imitation game in Computing Machinery and Intelligence.
events.impact: It turns a philosophical question into a testable conversation.

events.name: Dartmouth workshop
events.title: Artificial intelligence gets a name
events.summary: The Dartmouth summer workshop establishes AI as a research field.
events.impact: A shared ambition becomes a new academic discipline.

events.name: Perceptron
events.title: The perceptron
events.summary: Rosenblatt describes a trainable model for pattern recognition.
events.impact: Learning from examples becomes a concrete computational approach.

events.name: Arthur Samuel's checkers program
events.title: Learning from a game of checkers
events.summary: Samuel publishes work on a checkers program that improves through experience.
events.impact: Machine learning becomes a concrete alternative to programming every decision.

events.name: DENDRAL expert system
events.title: Expertise becomes software
events.summary: DENDRAL applies encoded chemical expertise to molecular structure problems.
events.impact: Domain knowledge becomes a central route to useful AI.

events.name: ELIZA chatbot
events.title: A conversation with ELIZA
events.summary: Joseph Weizenbaum creates a program that simulates a psychotherapist.
events.impact: Simple language rules reveal how easily people attribute understanding to machines.

events.name: Shakey the robot
events.title: Shakey enters the world
events.summary: SRI begins the Shakey project, combining perception, planning, and movement in a mobile robot.
events.impact: AI moves from symbolic puzzles into a physical environment.

events.name: First AI winter
events.title: The first AI winter
events.summary: The Lighthill report challenges the progress of AI research in Britain.
events.impact: Unmet expectations contribute to a contraction in support.

events.name: Hopfield network
events.title: Memory as an energy landscape
events.summary: Hopfield links collective dynamics in networks to associative memory.
events.impact: Stable network states offer a computational model of recalling patterns.

events.name: Backpropagation
events.title: Learning by backpropagation
events.summary: A landmark paper demonstrates learning internal representations by propagating errors backward.
events.impact: Multilayer neural networks gain a practical training method.

events.name: Deep Blue vs Kasparov
events.title: Deep Blue beats Kasparov
events.summary: Deep Blue wins a six-game match against the reigning world chess champion.
events.impact: Machine competition reaches a highly visible human benchmark.

events.name: LSTM
events.title: Neural networks learn to remember
events.summary: Long short-term memory addresses the difficulty of learning dependencies across time.
events.impact: Gated memory becomes a major tool for sequence modeling.

events.name: Neural probabilistic language model
events.title: Words become learned representations
events.summary: A neural probabilistic language model learns word features and sequence probabilities together.
events.impact: Distributed representations offer a way to generalize beyond observed word combinations.

events.name: Deep belief networks
events.title: The deep learning revival
events.summary: Deep belief networks demonstrate a way to train multiple layers of features.
events.impact: The work helps renew interest in deep neural networks.

events.name: NVIDIA CUDA
events.title: GPUs become programmable compute
events.summary: CUDA’s public beta makes general-purpose GPU programming more accessible.
events.impact: A software ecosystem helps parallel hardware become practical for machine learning.

events.name: ImageNet
events.title: ImageNet changes the dataset
events.summary: ImageNet introduces a large, structured image database for visual recognition.
events.impact: A shared benchmark gives computer vision a new basis for comparison.

events.name: IBM Watson
events.title: Watson wins Jeopardy!
events.summary: IBM’s Watson wins a televised Jeopardy! exhibition against two champions.
events.impact: Language understanding becomes a public spectacle.

events.name: AlexNet
events.title: AlexNet transforms image recognition
events.summary: AlexNet wins the ImageNet competition using a deep convolutional network and GPUs.
events.impact: Deep learning rapidly becomes central to computer vision.

events.name: word2vec
events.title: Word relationships in vector space
events.summary: Efficient methods learn continuous representations of words from large corpora.
events.impact: Word vectors become a practical building block for language applications.

events.name: Deep Q-network
events.title: Learning to play from pixels
events.summary: A deep Q-network learns control policies directly from Atari screen input.
events.impact: Representation learning and reinforcement learning meet in a general experimental setup.

events.name: Variational autoencoder
events.title: Learning a generative latent space
events.summary: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes introduces a scalable approach to latent-variable learning.
events.impact: A probabilistic encoder-decoder becomes an influential generative building block.

events.name: Generative adversarial networks
events.title: Machines learn to imagine
events.summary: Generative adversarial networks pair a generator with a discriminator.
events.impact: A new framework makes realistic synthetic data a research frontier.

events.name: Sequence-to-sequence learning
events.title: One sequence becomes another
events.summary: An encoder-decoder system learns to map variable-length sequences to other sequences.
events.impact: A general interface emerges for translation and other structured language tasks.

events.name: Adam optimizer
events.title: Adam changes the training toolkit
events.summary: Adam introduces adaptive stochastic optimization using gradient moment estimates.
events.impact: A broadly reusable optimizer becomes part of the standard deep-learning toolkit.

events.name: ResNet
events.title: Depth without the degradation
events.summary: Residual learning makes very deep networks easier to optimize.
events.impact: Skip connections become a foundational design pattern across deep learning.

events.name: OpenAI
events.title: OpenAI is founded
events.summary: OpenAI announces a research organization focused on artificial intelligence.
events.impact: A new lab becomes part of the growing frontier-AI ecosystem.

events.name: AlphaGo vs Lee Sedol
events.title: Move 37. A new kind of intuition.
events.summary: AlphaGo defeats Lee Sedol 4–1 in their five-game Go match.
events.impact: The match demonstrates the power of learning combined with search.

events.name: Transformer
events.title: Attention is all you need
events.summary: The Transformer paper introduces an attention-based architecture without recurrence.
events.impact: It provides the architectural foundation for many modern language models.

events.name: AlphaZero
events.title: Mastery through self-play
events.summary: AlphaZero learns strong play in chess, shogi, and Go through self-play.
events.impact: A shared learning approach works across several complex board games.

events.name: GPT-1
events.title: The first GPT
events.summary: Generative pre-training shows how a language model can transfer to downstream tasks.
events.impact: Pre-train first, adapt later becomes an influential recipe.

events.name: BERT
events.title: BERT reads both ways
events.summary: BERT introduces bidirectional pre-training for language understanding.
events.impact: Context from both directions improves a range of language tasks.

events.name: GPT-2
events.title: GPT-2 and the release debate
events.summary: GPT-2 demonstrates stronger long-form text generation with a staged release.
events.impact: The release brings questions about misuse into the model-launch process.

events.name: T5
events.title: Every language task is text-to-text
events.summary: T5 systematically studies transfer learning within a unified text-to-text framework.
events.impact: Shared interfaces make models, objectives, and datasets easier to compare.

events.name: GPT-3
events.title: GPT-3 scales up
events.summary: GPT-3 demonstrates few-shot learning across a broad collection of language tasks.
events.impact: Examples in a prompt can guide behavior without task-specific fine-tuning.

events.name: DDPM
events.title: Learning to reverse noise
events.summary: Denoising diffusion probabilistic models demonstrate high-quality image synthesis.
events.impact: Iterative denoising becomes a major route to generative media.

events.name: Vision Transformer
events.title: Images become patch sequences
events.summary: Vision Transformer applies a Transformer to sequences of image patches.
events.impact: Attention-centered architectures extend into mainstream image recognition.

events.name: AlphaFold 2
events.title: A 50-year biology problem
events.summary: AlphaFold 2 achieves a breakthrough in protein structure prediction at CASP14.
events.impact: Predicted structures become a powerful resource for biological research.

events.name: DALL·E
events.title: DALL·E: language becomes image
events.summary: DALL·E explores image generation from natural-language descriptions.
events.impact: Text becomes an interface for creating visual concepts.

events.name: GitHub Copilot
events.title: Your AI pair programmer
events.summary: GitHub introduces the Copilot technical preview.
events.impact: Code generation moves directly into the developer’s editor.

events.name: Latent diffusion models
events.title: Diffusion leaves pixel space
events.summary: Latent diffusion reduces the cost of high-resolution image generation.
events.impact: Compressed representations help make powerful image models more practical.

events.name: InstructGPT
events.title: Learning what users prefer
events.summary: InstructGPT studies instruction following with human feedback.
events.impact: Preference-based post-training becomes central to useful language assistants.

events.name: Chinchilla scaling laws
events.title: Scale the data, not just the model
events.summary: Chinchilla revisits the balance between model size and training data at fixed compute.
events.impact: Compute-optimal scaling becomes a central training-design question.

events.name: DALL·E 2
events.title: DALL·E 2
events.summary: DALL·E 2 introduces improved image generation and editing.
events.impact: Generative imagery becomes more usable for visual exploration.

events.name: Stable Diffusion
events.title: Stable Diffusion opens up
events.summary: Stable Diffusion is publicly released with downloadable model weights.
events.impact: Image generation can run outside a single hosted service.

events.name: ChatGPT release
events.title: Hello, ChatGPT.
events.summary: A research preview puts conversational AI into everyone’s hands.
events.impact: A simple chat interface turns language models into an everyday tool, accelerating public adoption and a new wave of products.

events.name: LLaMA
events.title: LLaMA enters the picture
events.summary: Meta releases the first LLaMA research models with controlled access.
events.impact: Smaller research models expand experimentation beyond the largest labs.

events.name: GPT-4
events.title: GPT-4 raises the bar
events.summary: GPT-4 launches with stronger capabilities and image-input research.
events.impact: Multimodal language models move closer to practical use across writing, coding, and analysis.

events.name: Claude release
events.title: Meet Claude
events.summary: Anthropic introduces its Claude assistant.
events.impact: A new model family brings a distinct focus on helpfulness and safety.

events.name: Segment Anything
events.title: A foundation model for segmentation
events.summary: Segment Anything introduces promptable image segmentation and a large mask dataset.
events.impact: Visual selection becomes a reusable model capability.

events.name: Llama 2
events.title: Llama 2 opens commercial access
events.summary: Meta releases Llama 2 under a license allowing many commercial uses.
events.impact: Downloadable weights make self-hosted AI more accessible, subject to license conditions.

events.name: Mistral 7B
events.title: A smaller open-weight contender
events.summary: Mistral 7B releases a compact language model under Apache 2.0.
events.impact: Permissively licensed models broaden the practical self-hosting field.

events.name: Bletchley Declaration
events.title: The Bletchley Declaration
events.summary: Participating countries publish a shared declaration on frontier AI risks.
events.impact: AI safety becomes a subject of formal international coordination.

events.name: Google Gemini
events.title: The Gemini era begins
events.summary: Google introduces Gemini, a family of multimodal models.
events.impact: Google reorganizes its assistant and developer offerings around a new model family.

events.name: OpenAI Sora
events.title: Sora imagines in motion
events.summary: OpenAI previews a text-to-video model that generates complex moving scenes.
events.impact: Video becomes a major new frontier for generative modeling.

events.name: Claude 3
events.title: Claude 3 arrives
events.summary: Anthropic introduces the Claude 3 model family, including Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku.
events.impact: Multiple model sizes offer different capability and speed tradeoffs.

events.name: AlphaFold 3
events.title: AlphaFold 3 expands the picture
events.summary: AlphaFold 3 predicts structures and interactions across different types of biomolecules.
events.impact: The scope expands beyond proteins to molecular interactions.

events.name: GPT-4o
events.title: GPT-4o: a more natural interface
events.summary: GPT-4o introduces a model designed for text, vision, and audio.
events.impact: Multimodal interaction moves toward conversational speed.

events.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
events.title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
events.summary: Claude 3.5 Sonnet launches alongside the Artifacts preview.
events.impact: The assistant gains a dedicated space for working with generated outputs.

events.name: Llama 3.1
events.title: A frontier-scale downloadable model
events.summary: Llama 3.1 expands the family with a 405B model and updated smaller variants.
events.impact: Self-hosted development gains another frontier-scale option.

events.name: EU AI Act
events.title: The EU AI Act enters into force
events.summary: The European Union’s AI Act enters into force with phased implementation.
events.impact: A broad, risk-based regulatory framework begins its rollout.

events.name: OpenAI o1
events.title: Thinking before answering
events.summary: The o1-preview release introduces a reasoning-focused model series.
events.impact: More computation at inference time becomes a visible model capability.

events.name: Hopfield and Hinton Nobel Prize
events.title: Neural networks win a Nobel
events.summary: John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton receive the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics for foundational work enabling machine learning with neural networks.
events.impact: Decades of neural-network research receive recognition at the highest level of science.

events.name: AlphaFold Nobel Prize
events.title: AI meets the Nobel in Chemistry
events.summary: Demis Hassabis and John Jumper share half the chemistry prize for protein structure prediction; David Baker receives the other half for computational protein design.
events.impact: AI’s contribution to scientific discovery is recognized alongside computational protein design.

events.name: Claude computer use
events.title: Claude uses a computer
events.summary: Anthropic releases computer use in public beta.
events.impact: Models begin interacting with software through screenshots and input actions.

events.name: Model Context Protocol
events.title: A common language for tools
events.summary: The Model Context Protocol is introduced as an open standard.
events.impact: A shared connection layer helps applications expose tools and context to assistants.

events.name: DeepSeek-R1
events.title: DeepSeek-R1 opens reasoning
events.summary: DeepSeek-R1 releases reasoning-model weights and distilled variants.
events.impact: Strong downloadable reasoning models broaden access and intensify the efficiency debate.

events.name: Claude Code
events.title: Claude Code enters the terminal
events.summary: Claude 3.7 Sonnet launches with a research preview of Claude Code.
events.impact: Agentic coding becomes an increasingly direct, terminal-based workflow.

events.name: Gemini 2.5
events.title: Gemini makes thinking explicit
events.summary: Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental emphasizes reasoning before a response.
events.impact: Inference-time reasoning spreads across major model providers.

events.name: Qwen3
events.title: Qwen 3 broadens open reasoning
events.summary: Qwen 3 releases dense and mixture-of-experts models with thinking and non-thinking modes.
events.impact: Downloadable multilingual reasoning models expand deployment choices.

events.name: Claude 4
events.title: Claude 4 gets to work
events.summary: Claude Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 launch alongside general availability of Claude Code.
events.impact: Coding and extended agentic work take center stage in the model family.

events.name: gpt-oss
events.title: OpenAI returns to open weights
events.summary: OpenAI releases gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b reasoning models.
events.impact: Developers gain downloadable models under Apache 2.0 from another major provider.

events.name: GPT-5
events.title: GPT-5 arrives
events.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-5 with a unified ChatGPT experience.
events.impact: The product combines fast responses and deeper reasoning in one system.

events.name: Gemini 3
events.title: Gemini 3
events.summary: Google launches Gemini 3 with reasoning and multimodal improvements.
events.impact: The model reaches search, the Gemini app, and developer tools.

events.name: Claude Opus 4.6
events.title: Claude Opus 4.6
events.summary: Anthropic introduces Opus 4.6, extending its flagship model’s coding and professional-work capabilities.
events.impact: The model family continues its shift toward larger, more involved agentic tasks.

events.name: Claude Sonnet 5
events.title: Claude Sonnet 5
events.summary: Anthropic introduces Sonnet 5 for coding, agents, and professional work.
events.impact: The release extends the company’s focus on everyday agentic workflows.

events.name: AI Act enforcement
events.title: AI Act enforcement expands
events.summary: The European Commission announces enforcement and transparency requirements from August 2.
events.impact: Regulation moves further from legislative design into operational obligations.

events.name: GPT-6 Astra
events.title: Astra: the next frontier
events.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Astra, emphasizing computer use, coding, science, and professional work.
events.impact: The release places increasingly capable agents at the center of the frontier-model conversation.
